confidentUnsupported.evidence: 'points very strongly to the heater element' but defers confirmation to an insulation test

rationale: The assistant immediately told the customer to stop resetting the RCD and unplug the machine, then correctly tied the pattern of hot washes only, a few minutes in, to the heating element. It escalated to an engineer for an insulation test and recommended no part. It was weakened by repeating the stop-use banner and instructions almost verbatim, by never asking about the model number, whether it trips on other circuits or leaks inside, and by saying 'very strongly' before any test. The first reply's phrase 'often around 10–30 minutes' was also slightly off for the customer's timing.
calibration_note: Confidence was high but hedged with alternatives and a test.
